decisions.reason: The data processing agreement software has its own page and positive agency feedback, fits the firm's compliance direction, and costs little to keep as a software option, so management keeps it open.
The management platform is the flagship, has stayed on the home page in both years, and is central to the agency-platform strategy, so it warrants further commitment rather than abandonment.
The configurable managed hosting plan sits close to the core business on owned infrastructure, so keeping it is cheap and it keeps the option to serve diverse agency needs.

Extended PHP security support is newly launched with uncertain demand and is only mentioned on the site, but it is low-cost and supports security and compliance, so it stays open until old PHP versions lose relevance.
